changeSet.author: swap-deposit-fix
changeSet.comment: Repair the SOL->USDT_TON swap order that was falsely marked COMPLETED by an unrelated incoming USDT-TON deposit on its destination wallet (the deposit's tx hash was claimed as the payout and the real DEPOSIT row was swallowed). Clears dest_tx_hash / amount_out_actual and moves the order to REFUND_PENDING so the status poller reconciles it with the provider; clearing the hash lets the next wallet scan re-record the swallowed deposit. Acts only when exactly one such COMPLETED order exists. Going forward the deposit matcher is gated by asset + amount + recency and DEST_AWAITING orders time out (see SwapStatusService / SwapExpirationSweeper).
